newsitem.title: USA: Venezuela Amuay cat cracker back at "normal" level.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Amuay cat cracker back at "normal" level.

text.p: The catalytic cracker at Venezuela's Amuay refinery was returned to "normal" levels late Friday following the breakdown of an air compressor, a spokesman for state Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) unit Lagoven said.
The cat cracker is now running at its usual level of 90,000 bpd, although full capacity is 108,000 bpd, he said.
Some sources said the cat cracker could be running as high as 100,000 bpd.
A failed air compressor forced the unit to shut down October 20, with export commitments met from Amuay inventories and the nearby Cardon and Curacao refineries.
The cat cracker is used to produce gasoline.
Venezuela is the major foreign gasoline supplier to the United States, shipping about 48,000 bpd over the first half of 1996, according to the U.S. Department of Energy.
